title: Load of each server
statement:
Print one array with a label for every load, in the same order.

The input is an array of CPU loads in percent. For 90 or more, the label is `"critical"`. For 70 up to 89, it is `"warning"`. For anything lower, it is `"normal"`.
reference: map(if . >= 90 then "critical" elif . >= 70 then "warning" else "normal" end)
